ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( RIGHT( LOWER( Email ) , 6) = ".games", RIGHT( LOWER( Email ) , 7) = ".garden", RIGHT( LOWER( Email ) , 6) = ".glass", RIGHT( LOWER( Email ) , 5) = ".free", RIGHT( LOWER( Email ) , 5) = ".talk" )
